players.product: Ultrastar DC SN861 PCIe Gen5 enterprise SSD

quarterly_data.signal: Sandisk's June 2025 prospectus: Flash Ventures (its manufacturing ventures with Kioxia) has historically operated at nearly 100% of its manufacturing capacity, but Sandisk temporarily reduced utilization of its share to an abnormally low level to align wafer supply with projected demand, incurring underutilization charges of $24 million in the nine months ended March 28, 2025 (a period the prospectus describes as what Sandisk believes is a mid-cycle slowdown, with additional charges expected as it moderated production levels for the rest of fiscal 2025) versus $249 million in the nine months ended March 29, 2024 and $286 million in fiscal 2023. Sandisk reduced its portion of Flash Ventures capital expenditures to approximately $773 million in 2024 from approximately $1.4 billion in 2023.
quarterly_data.figure: underutilization charges $24 million (nine months to March 28, 2025) vs $249 million; Flash Ventures capex share approximately $773 million (2024) vs approximately $1.4 billion (2023)

quarterly_data.signal: Sandisk's prospectus lists its material cash requirements as of March 28, 2025: Flash Ventures related commitments of $4,592 million ($940 million in the remaining three months of fiscal 2025, $2,606 million in 2026-2027) and purchase obligations and other commitments of $2,781 million, which include long-term agreements with suppliers containing fixed future commitments contingent on the performance, quality and technology of the vendors' components.
quarterly_data.figure: Flash Ventures related commitments $4,592 million; purchase obligations and other commitments $2,781 million (March 28, 2025)
